title: Prompt Chat — Inline Shader Generation Prompt with Edit Mode
description: Create the PromptChat component that provides an inline prompt input for shader generation on the selected layer. Supports creation mode (new shader from prompt) and edit mode (re-open with existing prompt for modification). Shows generation status (idle, loading/streaming, error, success). Integrates with the AI service layer to generate shaders and with ProjectStore to apply results to layers.
acceptance_criteria: PromptChat renders inline prompt input below/within selected layer context
TextArea input for shader prompt with submit button
Create mode: empty prompt, submit generates new shader
Edit mode: pre-filled with existing prompt, submit regenerates shader
Status display: idle, loading (with streaming indicator), error (with message), success
Calls AI service generateShader and applies result to ProjectStore
completion_summary: PromptChat with create/edit modes, streaming display, error handling with retry, cancel support, Ctrl+Enter submit, auto-focus, AI provider integration via OpenRouter. Typecheck passes.
